title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When the testing error increases while the training error decreases, it often indicates a problem with the model's complexity. Consider how bias and variance play a role in this scenario.

title: Model Complexity and Overfitting
text: Adding more features can increase the model's complexity. This might lead to overfitting, where the model performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data. Think about how this affects bias and variance.

title: Identifying Overfitting
text: What happens to the bias and variance when a model becomes too complex?

title: Impact of Overfitting on Errors
text: In the context of overfitting, why does the testing error increase while the training error decreases? Consider the model's ability to generalize to new data.

hintAnswer: The model fits the training data too closely and fails to generalize well to new data, leading to higher testing error.
